output_list.criticism: This vulnerability is categorized as Reentrancy. A Reentrancy exploit is when a contract can be called again by a user inside its own execution. This way, the user can be tricked into multiple interactions with the contract during one single transaction, resulting in a large loss of the user's funds in exchange for one small contract bug. This vulnerability is exploitable. Severity is 5 out of 10: Vulnerable code directly interacts with the sender. Profitability is also 5 out of 10: This flaw can be used by any external players to take away assets.
